Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Mystic hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 6 of the 12 Mystic hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 2, Booking.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, Super.com at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. These are the Mystic rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 6 of the 10 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Mystic hotels

At the 7 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($41 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Howard Johnson by Wyndham Mystic to 15% at The Whaler's Inn Hotel of Mystic. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
